text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I hear someone talking rather animatedly
from
the training track's stands and head
over to check
things out...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, I see, I see! I gotta save that move
for
later...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh, wow! Look at her run! She's just
incredible!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if she used her pivot foot to do
that?
Ooh, she broke away from the
pack so cleanly...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hello! Are you here to watch the
others as
they train too?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Everyone here really is amazing. It's like,
they're
not Tracen students for nothing,
you know?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
The way that racer accelerates in the
final stretch
is so awesome.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
The timing of her last spurt was
unbelievable too!
I should really ask how
she does it.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Also, the racer over there has an
incredible
amount of stamina!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh right, she's the one that always eats
mountains
of food at lunch. That must
be the key, huh?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Not to mention Ikuno Dictus over there
doing
some solo training.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Huh? I think they're pretty average,
actually.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I really don't have any special skills of
my own, so
watching everyone closely is
the least I can do.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
That's why I always get so excited
whenever I
discover someone new and
amazing.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
That's why I always get so excited
whenever I
discover someone new and
amazing.
choice_data_list: その機敏さは普通じゃないような
普通とは言えないパワーだ
普通とは言えないパワーだね

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Aw, you flatterer! Praising me will get
you
nowhere, you know!
choice_data_list: その機敏さは普通じゃないような
普通とは言えないパワーだ
普通とは言えないパワーだね

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
'Sides, I know better than anyone else
how
average I—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Wait a minute. Why is Ikuno using her
legs like
that? That's different than what
she usually
does...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Could it be? Is she trying out a new
form? Ooh,
what could it be?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, but I really gotta find out! Hey,
Ikuno!
Heeeey!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser runs off at a speed
that can
hardly be considered "average."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?! Don't flatter me like that!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I really am just a very average
Umamusume... Oh,
hold on. Has Ikuno
finished training already?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, but I want to go over there and
help her
out.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
She used a lot of equipment, so I'm sure
she'll
need a hand putting everything
away!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I don't think I'll actually be of much
help, but
cleanup will still be faster with
two people than
one.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser helps clean up with
way
more than average strength, and the
task is done
in the blink of an eye.
